SQLx SQLite driver security backport

Source: crates.io sqlx-sqlite 0.8.6, upstream launchbadge/sqlx commit
bab1b022bd56a64f9a08b46b36b97c5cff19d77e, directory sqlx-sqlite.
Source files and both upstream licenses are unchanged, including upstream
doc-comment trailing spaces; the scoped Git whitespace attribute preserves them.

Only the normalized Cargo.toml dependency on libsqlite3-sys changes from
0.30.1 to 0.39.1, which bundles SQLite 3.54.1 and fixes RUSTSEC-2026-0459
(CVE-2026-119375). The original manifest is retained as Cargo.toml.orig.

Advisory: https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0459
SQLx 0.8.6 requires libsqlite3-sys 0.30.x. Published SQLx 0.9.0 also caps
libsqlite3-sys below the patched version. This local backport retains the
SQLx 0.8 APIs and PostgreSQL driver while using patched bundled SQLite.

Remove the workspace patch when a compatible published SQLx release allows
libsqlite3-sys >=0.39.1. Keep this package excluded from workspace membership
so first-party lint policy does not require modifying upstream driver code.
